what: Where the work has gone, and what has come back. One row per outward send, with the status word meant exactly. This is a RECORD, not prose: the About page renders it, so updating a status is a record edit and the page cannot quietly go stale.

statusWords.public, no reply: visible to everyone, answered by nobody
statusWords.filed, no reply: received by the other party's tracker, unanswered
statusWords.posted, no reply: published where it was aimed, unanswered
statusWords.open, no comments: an issue nobody has responded to
statusWords.live, no reply: a comment visible in the thread, unanswered
statusWords.posted, visibility unconfirmed: submitted, and we have not verified it appeared
statusWords.submitted, awaiting moderation: in a queue, not yet visible
statusWords.still in the moderation queue: submitted and confirmed not yet visible
statusWords.answered: the other party replied in the thread; what came back is in the note
statusWords.reviewed, not merged: a reviewer who is not a maintainer answered in the review; nothing merged
statusWords.merged: accepted into the other party's repository
statusWords.closed, no comment: the other party closed it without a reply
